content.text:
I've reviewed the full document. Findings from my investigation:

- **Section 1 (Purpose of Engagement)** — pure scope/SOW mechanics; no limitation on competing products or services.
- **p0019–p0020 (Section 4)** — the only "shall not" binding Company is a license-scope limit on *Contractor's own* pre-existing proprietary materials ("Company shall not resell or make use of said property in any other manner other than in connection with the software Company receives"). This constrains reuse of vendor-owned IP, not the businesses we operate or the products we may buy or build — an IP/license-scope issue, not a non-compete or field-of-use restraint.
- **p0019** actually runs the other way: it preserves *Contractor's* freedom to serve other clients.
- **p0047 (Non-Solicitation)** — mutual, employee-only, 1 year, consent not unreasonably withheld. Personnel non-solicit, not a non-compete or field-of-use restriction, and it binds both parties equally.
- No territory, exclusivity, "competing products," or "compete with Contractor" language anywhere; the only "compet"/"exclusiv" hits were "court of competent jurisdiction," "sole and exclusive property," and "complete and exclusive agreement."

No restrictive covenant binds Clear Capital's business. This is compliant, so I will submit without a redline.

input.quote: (b) Company acknowledges that Contractor provides consulting and development services to other clients, and agrees that nothing in this Agreement shall be deemed or construed to prevent Contractor from delivering on such business.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binding Clear Capital, so the preferred position is met and no redline is needed. Section 1 is limited to SOW and scope mechanics with no limitation on competing products or services, and a full-text scan for "compet", "shall not develop/engage/market/sell", "field of use", "exclusiv", and "restrict" surfaced no restraint on our business (hits were only "court of competent jurisdiction", "sole and exclusive property", and "complete and exclusive agreement"). The only restrictive covenant, Section 13 (p0047), is a mutual, employee-only non-solicit of one year with consent not to be unreasonably withheld; it is a personnel non-solicit rather than a non-compete or field-of-use restraint, and it binds both parties reciprocally. The single "Company shall not" in p0020 is a license-scope limit on Contractor's own pre-existing proprietary materials and Contractor's Information ("shall not resell or make use of said property in any other manner other than in connection with the software Company receives"); that constrains reuse of vendor-owned IP rather than the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build, so it falls under IP/license-scope review rather than this rule. Paragraph p0019 runs in the opposite direction, preserving Contractor's freedom to serve other clients, which is a restriction-free provision benefiting the counterparty and not something to flag under this rule.
